facts.fact: ANIP says that in the ten pilot health facilities the child's NPI is generated within a maximum of 72 hours of the birth registration and sent by SMS to the parent; over 13,000 of 17,071 children declared were registered.

facts.fact: ANIP, the national identification agency, says it attributes the unique national identifier (NPI) from the RNPP, which it calls the single reliable register of identification, and generated NPIs for over 13,000 pilot-registered children.

BEN.note: No local government office connection stated.

facts.fact: ANIP says the RNPP is the base of identification in Benin and is to be consolidated as the single reliable register for every Beninese.
ANIP says children registered at birth in the pilot health facilities are entered in the RNPP from birth, improving its data quality.
ANIP says births are declared and registered in the maternity at ten pilot public health facilities, launched 20 August 2025 at CHU-MEL Cotonou.

facts.fact: ANIP says the single-window registration ran as a pilot in ten public health facilities between August 2025 and February 2026, with arrondissement chiefs to be empowered to declare out-of-facility births before 31 December 2026.
facts.system: Guichet Unique de declaration des Naissances
